text:
Ava: Quick follow-up from the KV OOM incident Root goal: short owners + concrete next steps so we can close mitigations.
Jordan: I'll take eviction-policy sweeps and basic dashboards.
Rene: I'll run allocation snapshots and a focused fragment analysis.
Ava: Actions:
 - Rene: deterministic replay + heap snapshots, produce flamegraph + 2-line summary. ETA: Wed EOD.
 - Jordan: segmented/LRU/TTL eviction experiments on staging, publish evictions/sec and p99 miss-latency graphs. ETA: Fri.
 - Ava: coordinate canary for jemalloc purge cadence (10% traffic) and watch p99/CPU. ETA: Mon AM.
 - infra-bot: create tracking tickets and attach last-night OOM logs.
infra-bot: Tickets INF-5010 (alloc-profiling), INF-5011 (eviction-sweeps), INF-5012 (allocator-canary) created.
oncall: Please set temp alert windows when running noisy replays.
Rene: Note: will include both sampling and full snapshots; sampling misses tiny short-lived allocs.
Jordan: If eviction reduces resident but spikes miss-latency, we'll prototype hotset pinning.
Ava: Proposed lightweight cadence: 1-line daily updates on each ticket + weekly 30m sync Thu 09:00 PST for 3 weeks. I'll send invites.
Rene: Uploading first flamegraph to INF-5010 later today.
Jordan: Starting segmentation tests in staging in 2h.
Ava: Thanks. Tag me on blockers.
